ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: Allow My LOOI to see a scene you explicitly ask it to look at and optionally detect faces on-device.
ios.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Allow My LOOI to hear wake phrases, safety commands and your conversations.
ios.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: Allow My LOOI to connect to your LOOI robot.
ios.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Expo Dev Launcher uses the local network to discover and connect to development servers running on your computer.
